ordinary.text: A seed starts as a tiny package with all the parts a growing plant needs, like food and instructions. When the seed gets the right mix of water, sunlight, and soil, it cracks open, and a new plant grows out of it, eventually becoming a tree.

marked.text: A seed starts as a tiny package with all the parts a growing plant needs. When the seed has the right conditions—like water, sunlight, and soil—it sprouts a small plant, which grows taller over time and becomes a tree.
